post.summary: Irreversibly clear household job and points data.
post.description: Deletes jobs, recurring series, review decisions, and points entries in one transaction. Requires the exact confirmation phrase 'RESET TASKS AND POINTS'. User profiles and credentials are preserved.

get.summary: Get the household bootstrap or sign-in state.

post.summary: Create or claim the first household adult.
Sign in a selected household member with a PIN.
Rotate a same-origin refresh token and renew access.
Revoke the current session and clear its cookie.
Consume a one-time handoff and set the target member PIN.

get.summary: List active or all household members for administration.

post.summary: Create an active household member awaiting PIN setup.

patch.summary: Update a household member's profile names.

delete.summary: Deactivate a household member and revoke their access.

post.summary: Restore a deactivated household member.
Authorize a one-time PIN handoff to an unconfigured member.
Reset another active member's PIN and authorize a private replacement handoff.

get.summary: Get the authenticated family member's daily board.
get.description: Returns the child-owned or adult household view for the optional household-local date and adult-only child filter.

post.summary: Mark an open job complete and pending approval.
post.description: Returns 409 when the job has already been completed.

post.summary: Schedule a once-off job for one or more children.
post.description: Adds an independent job to each selected child's board for a household-local date.

post.summary: Create a daily recurring job for one or more children.
post.description: Creates an adult-owned child-specific daily series for each assignee and materializes duplicate-safe occurrences through an eight-week horizon.

post.summary: Create a weekly recurring job for one or more children.
post.description: Creates an adult-owned child-specific weekly series for each assignee and materializes duplicate-safe occurrences through an eight-week horizon.

post.summary: Create a monthly recurring job for one or more children.
post.description: Creates an adult-owned child-specific monthly series for each assignee and uses the final valid day in shorter months.

post.summary: Approve a pending job and award its points.
post.description: Returns 409 unless the job is pending approval or its points were already awarded.

post.summary: Reject a pending job and return it for another try.
post.description: Records optional feedback and returns 409 unless the job is pending approval.

put.summary: Edit an open or pending-approval job occurrence.
put.description: Updates only this job occurrence without changing its recurring series or points ledger; approved and cancelled jobs return 409.

post.summary: Cancel an open or pending-approval job occurrence.
post.description: Records an optional reason, hides the occurrence from daily agendas, and leaves its recurring series and review history unchanged.

get.summary: List the good behaviour types adults can log.
get.description: Returns active types with the points each usually earns. Any signed-in family member may read this list; the amount awarded for a logged behaviour can differ.

post.summary: Create a good behaviour type.
post.description: Adult-only. The type is immediately available to log for any active child.

put.description: Adult-only. Previously logged behaviours keep the name, description, and points they were logged with. Returns 409 for a deleted type.

delete.description: Adult-only soft delete: the type can no longer be logged, and history is unchanged. Repeating the request succeeds.

post.summary: Log a good behaviour for one or more children and award its points.
post.description: Adult-only. Creates an independent behaviour and points ledger entry for each selected child, all in one transaction. Points default to the type's points and apply to each child. Repeating a request ID with the same details returns the original result without a second award; reusing it for different details returns 409.

post.summary: Manually add or remove points for a child.
post.description: Adult-only. Records a signed, non-zero adjustment with a required reason as its own append-only ledger entry; mistakes are corrected with a new opposite adjustment. An adjustment that would take the balance below zero returns 409 with code 'negativeBalanceConfirmationRequired' and the current and resulting balances unless confirmNegativeBalance is true. Repeating a request ID with the same details returns the original result without a second entry; reusing it for different details returns 409 with code 'requestConflict'.

Bearer.description: Short-lived access token returned by the household sign-in flow.
